stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪得 MathArena 桂冠，但成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高出 15 倍 / Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol

sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. The article Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 這段時間以來首次，沒有 OpenAI 模型在 MathArena AI 數學基準測試中領先。Google's Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Anthropic's Fable 5.2 將 GPT-6.1 Sol 擠下了榜首，儘管兩者的成本高出許多。Gemini 在測試中忽略了時間限制，並且幾乎從不放棄任何任務。

stories.title: 在創紀錄的 IPO 前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 坦言「明年會發生什麼事存在巨大不確定性」 / Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO

sources.title: 在創紀錄的 IPO 前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 坦言「明年會發生什麼事存在巨大不確定性」 / Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.title_zh: 在創紀錄的 IPO 前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 坦言「明年會發生什麼事存在巨大不確定性」
sources.title_en: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.title_original: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty. The article Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在可能成為史上規模最大IPO的前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 稱購買運算能力是其公司面臨的「最深層的商業困境」。Anthropic's 的承諾金額現在總計近 9010 億美元，未來營收是否能合理化這些成本，目前仍很不確定。這項計畫中的 IPO 主要旨在作為因應此不確定性的財務緩衝。

stories.title: OpenAI 將機器人研究人員重新分配至其他團隊，因為通用模型可能會使專門的機器人 AI 變得不再必要 / OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary

sources.title: OpenAI 將機器人研究人員重新分配至其他團隊，因為通用模型可能會使專門的機器人 AI 變得不再必要 / OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 將機器人研究人員重新分配至其他團隊，因為通用模型可能會使專門的機器人 AI 變得不再必要
sources.title_en: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.title_original: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.summary: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary. The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts. The article OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在解散其獨立的機器人團隊，這已是第二次，但並非因為缺乏數據。像 GPT-6 Astra 這樣的通用模型顯然可以直接控制機器人，使得專門的單位變得不再必要。研究人員被重新分配到其他團隊，公司將此形容為一種加速其機器人研發工作的方式。

sources.summary: Former OpenAI and Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon points to a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow as a reason he left, saying it shows the company's algorithms are improving not just quickly but at an accelerating rate. Coxon continues to call for a pause on frontier model development so competitors can catch up and human-level AI can become a commodity. The article Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 前OpenAI與Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon指出Anthropic's首次公開募股（IPO）路演中的一張幻燈片是他離職的原因，並表示這顯示該公司的演算法不僅進步迅速，而且是以加速的速度在成長。Coxon持續呼籲暫停前沿模型開發，以便競爭對手能夠迎頭趕上，並使人類水準的AI成為一種商品。

stories.title: Runway's 開源 Praxis-1 將影片 AI 轉化為機器人控制器 / Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller

sources.title_original: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
sources.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Runway 發布了其機器人模型 Praxis-1，採用 Apache 2.0 授權條款開放權重與原始碼。該模型利用來自影片訓練的知識來進行機器人控制，並在 Nvidia 的 RoboLab-120 評測中名列世界行動模型（World Action Model）類別的榜首。不過，它目前還無法自行規劃複雜的動作序列。

items.title_original: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
items.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Runway 發布了其機器人模型 Praxis-1，採用 Apache 2.0 授權條款開放權重與原始碼。該模型利用來自影片訓練的知識來進行機器人控制，並在 Nvidia 的 RoboLab-120 評測中名列世界行動模型（World Action Model）類別的榜首。不過，它目前還無法自行規劃複雜的動作序列。

sources.title_en: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
sources.title_original: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
sources.summary: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 史丹佛大學研究人員發表了 Memorilla，這是一個開源記憶系統，可將文件集合壓縮成適用於凍結 Qwen3-8B 的 16 個記憶權杖。它在使用比完整上下文少 108 倍的文件權杖的情況下，在 FactKG 上達到 84.33%。

sources.title_original: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 發布了 Vercel UI SDK，這是一個包含 50 多種 UI 行為的 Apache-2.0 授權測試版函式庫。編碼代理程式可將它們組合成為 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components 的無障礙元件，並具備用於直接 UI 控制的橋接器。

sources.title: Hugging Face TRL 修復使 SDPA 測試中的 Qwen3 H100 步驟時間減半 / Hugging Face TRL fix halves a Qwen3 H100 step in SDPA test
sources.title_zh: Hugging Face TRL 修復使 SDPA 測試中的 Qwen3 H100 步驟時間減半
sources.title_en: Hugging Face TRL fix halves a Qwen3 H100 step in SDPA test
sources.title_original: Hugging Face TRL fix halves a Qwen3 H100 step in SDPA test
sources.summary: Hugging Face contributor tests report an H100 SDPA step falling from 2.06 to 1.02 seconds; on Trainium2, the revised code produced step timings where the previous path crashed.
sources.summary_zh: Hugging Face 貢獻者測試回報 H100 SDPA 步驟從 2.06 秒縮短至 1.02 秒；在 Trainium2 上，修改後的程式碼產生的步驟計時，其先前的路徑會發生當機。

events.news_summary: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪下 MathArena 榜首，但成本為 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 15 倍。

sources.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪得 MathArena 桂冠，但成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高出 15 倍 / Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪得 MathArena 桂冠，但成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高出 15 倍
sources.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. The article Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 這段時間以來首次，沒有 OpenAI 模型在 MathArena AI 數學基準測試中領先。Google's Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Anthropic's Fable 5.2 將 GPT-6.1 Sol 擠下了榜首，儘管兩者的成本高出許多。Gemini 在測試中忽略了時間限制，並且幾乎從不放棄任何任務。

events.news_summary: Runway 發布開源機器人模型 Praxis-1，採用 Apache 2.0 授權，在 Nvidia RoboLab-120 基準測試中領先。

sources.title: Runway's 開源 Praxis-1 將影片 AI 轉化為機器人控制器 / Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
sources.title_zh: Runway's 開源 Praxis-1 將影片 AI 轉化為機器人控制器
sources.title_en: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
sources.title_original: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
sources.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Runway 發布了其機器人模型 Praxis-1，採用 Apache 2.0 授權條款開放權重與原始碼。該模型利用來自影片訓練的知識來進行機器人控制，並在 Nvidia 的 RoboLab-120 評測中名列世界行動模型（World Action Model）類別的榜首。不過，它目前還無法自行規劃複雜的動作序列。

sources.title: 在創紀錄的 IPO 前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 坦言「明年會發生什麼事存在巨大不確定性」 / Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.title_zh: 在創紀錄的 IPO 前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 坦言「明年會發生什麼事存在巨大不確定性」
sources.title_en: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.title_original: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
sources.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty. The article Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在可能成為史上規模最大IPO的前幾天，Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 稱購買運算能力是其公司面臨的「最深層的商業困境」。Anthropic's 的承諾金額現在總計近 9010 億美元，未來營收是否能合理化這些成本，目前仍很不確定。這項計畫中的 IPO 主要旨在作為因應此不確定性的財務緩衝。

sources.title: 史丹佛研究團隊開源 Memorilla，這是一個針對凍結 LLMs 的潛在記憶模組 / Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
sources.title_zh: 史丹佛研究團隊開源 Memorilla，這是一個針對凍結 LLMs 的潛在記憶模組
sources.title_en: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
sources.title_original: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
sources.summary: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 史丹佛大學研究人員發表了 Memorilla，這是一個開源記憶系統，可將文件集合壓縮成適用於凍結 Qwen3-8B 的 16 個記憶權杖。它在使用比完整上下文少 108 倍的文件權杖的情況下，在 FactKG 上達到 84.33%。

events.news_summary: OpenAI解散獨立機器人團隊，因GPT-6 Astra等通用模型可直接控制機器人，研究人員將調派至其他團隊。

sources.title: OpenAI 將機器人研究人員重新分配至其他團隊，因為通用模型可能會使專門的機器人 AI 變得不再必要 / OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 將機器人研究人員重新分配至其他團隊，因為通用模型可能會使專門的機器人 AI 變得不再必要
sources.title_en: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.title_original: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
sources.summary: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary. The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts. The article OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在解散其獨立的機器人團隊，這已是第二次，但並非因為缺乏數據。像 GPT-6 Astra 這樣的通用模型顯然可以直接控制機器人，使得專門的單位變得不再必要。研究人員被重新分配到其他團隊，公司將此形容為一種加速其機器人研發工作的方式。

sources.title: 前研究員Coxon表示，Anthropic已經能夠以「原本所需算力的一小部分」重新訓練Mythos / Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon

sources.title_original: Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon
sources.summary: Former OpenAI and Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon points to a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow as a reason he left, saying it shows the company's algorithms are improving not just quickly but at an accelerating rate. Coxon continues to call for a pause on frontier model development so competitors can catch up and human-level AI can become a commodity. The article Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 前OpenAI與Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon指出Anthropic's首次公開募股（IPO）路演中的一張幻燈片是他離職的原因，並表示這顯示該公司的演算法不僅進步迅速，而且是以加速的速度在成長。Coxon持續呼籲暫停前沿模型開發，以便競爭對手能夠迎頭趕上，並使人類水準的AI成為一種商品。

source_material.title: Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon
source_material.summary: Former OpenAI and Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon points to a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow as a reason he left, saying it shows the company's algorithms are improving not just quickly but at an accelerating rate. Coxon continues to call for a pause on frontier model development so competitors can catch up and human-level AI can become a commodity. The article Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon appeared first on The Decoder .

Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents

Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. Claude Code 的 /doctor prompt-audit 指令會檢查 CLAUDE.md、skills、agents 與 commands，找出為舊模型寫的提示寫法、失效路徑與互相矛盾的規則，並先產出報告，使用者確認後才會修改。

Google 的智慧眼鏡已開放預購，預定 12 月 10 日上市。拆開兩個品牌的售價、帳戶與手機限制、Guided Vision 用途，以及相機影像和對話文字的隱私邊界。
